0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 1-3 on the road, 15th in the East and 5.5 games out of the Atlantic lead) visit the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back), and both teams still have one game to play before this one. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Nets lost their 2025-26 season series 0-4, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise), and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture).
